verdict.rationale: Loops is an email platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints is a fair question for it. However, no evidence item mentions unsubscribe handling, bounce or complaint suppression, or compliance across transactional and marketing sends. Domain setup and Guardian message checks are related features but do not show suppression behavior.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
